Mahindra XUV 7XO receives 5‑star rating in Bharat NCAP crash tests

Mahindra's XUV 7XO was subjected to Bharat NCAP crash testing and earned a 5‑star safety rating. The rating was reported by the Hindi‑language outlet Haribhoomi and the English‑language outlet Times Now. Bharat NCAP evaluates vehicles on occupant protection and safety‑feature performance. A 5‑star rating indicates the vehicle met the programme’s highest safety standards. Both outlets presented the rating without noting any dispute or additional commentary.
